variants.reason: Manufacturer-confirmed 115 PS/200 Nm turbo-direct-injection engine with 6MT or 7DSG; adequate for ordinary use, but modest reserve under full family load and exact-code longevity/repair-cost evidence is incomplete.

The 81 kW output is real, but Czech inspection data for the Scala 1.0 TSI 81 kW group show significantly more serious whole-vehicle defects than same-age/same-fuel cars (O/E 1.56; 5,281 inspections; 95% CI 1.31–1.83). This does not prove engine unreliability; the signal needs component-level explanation and independent replication before recommendation.

value.architecture: EA211 three-cylinder turbocharged petrol, direct injection

notes: The 115 and 110 labels are not interchangeable: official documents show 85 kW/115 PS at launch and 81 kW/110 KM in later specifications.

Czech STK data contain an adverse total-vehicle defect signal for the 81 kW variant, but do not show which faults are engine-related. Keep it on hold rather than treating it as either proven bad or recommended.
